title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Statement Glossary: Missing-Credit Interest Base
content:
**Missing-credit interest base.** For a notice that a Marlowe & Finch refund settled to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account has not been credited, the missing-credit interest base is the purchase interest charged on the latest statement when that statement charged purchase interest; when the latest statement charged only the minimum interest charge, the missing-credit interest base is that minimum interest charge; when the latest statement charged no interest, it is zero.

The latest statement is the account's most recent statement by statement date; the interest it charged is the interest entries belonging to its billing period.

## Table

| Interest on the latest statement | Missing-credit interest base |
|---|---|
| purchase interest | that purchase interest |
| only the minimum interest charge | that minimum interest charge |
| none | zero |

## Examples (hypothetical statements)

| Latest statement | Base |
|---|---|
| USD 18.65 purchase interest | USD 18.65 |
| a USD 2.00 minimum interest charge and no purchase interest | USD 2.00 |
| no interest; the grace period held | zero |
